message:
I remember a time when my phone decided to lose its charge right when I needed it most. I was out with the grandkids, and suddenly, my trusty device was as useful as a brick. It got me thinking about how important it is to be prepared for those unexpected moments, especially when it comes to our vehicles. 

I recently came across a helpful resource that offers tips on what to keep in your car for emergencies. It's a great reminder that a little preparation can go a long way in keeping our families safe and sound. After all, it's always better to be ready than to find ourselves in a pinch. Have you thought about what you'd want in your car during an unexpected adventure?
